item: A release-run restore that failed reads error, not measured; a resume retakes it; the passphrase is kept out of what the restore child, a kept fresh install and the P0 report write
key_paths: src/monitoring/release_run.py; src/monitoring/release_run_fresh_restore.py; src/monitoring/p0_validation.py; src/monitoring/secret_scrub.py; src/api/diagnostics/release_run.py; src/static/app-diagnostics.js; tests/test_release_run.py; tests/test_p0_validation.py; tests/test_secret_scrub.py; docs/product/RELEASE_0.4_GATE.md
summary: From the 2026-09-30 diagnostics: two of the four release runs that reached the restore (instances 085218 and 085230, both run on 2026-09-26) had failed there, one refused by the restore engine's own staging check after 128 s and one dead after 53 minutes with Error creating function, and the report recorded both as measured with rows A and I over an empty restore block (row K read measured from the P0 trio, its scan of the restored corpus empty): the phase was measured whenever the parent returned, and neither the child's own ok nor its exit status was read. A restore now counts only when its child reported ok, its process exited 0 and its restore was committed; otherwise the phase reads error with the child's own words, rows A and I read error, rows E and K say the restored install's reading is not counted, and a resume retakes the restore and owes the passphrase as a first run does (the pre-migration restore included); a state file an earlier build wrote keeps no restore this rule would not count. The passphrase is taken out of what the child says where it writes its result and again where the parent records it, and out of the run journal and import reports a kept fresh install leaves on the drive (a file that cannot be rewritten is removed). On its first push CodeQL raised three high clear-text alerts that were the scrubber's own name and a test fixture's, not a passphrase reaching a file; the names became scrub_value and NEEDLE and the next head read no new alerts. Main's own red (the blocking ruff lane, the style ratchet at 439 against a ceiling of 436, three French strings) is ported from PR #1311 byte for byte so this PR's tests run in CI. The independent read of the head 87e5284e found one blocking fault and three should-fixes here, fixed with tests. Each restore attempt's directory was named by the backup's label and the process id and made with exist_ok, so a second release run in one server restored into the first one's kept install and a later run that did not keep its install deleted it: the name now has a random part and the directory is made with exist_ok=False. The wait on the restore child never read its pipes, so a child that wrote more than a pipe holds (70,000 bytes against 60,000 that went through) stayed blocked until the run was cancelled: the wait now reads them while it waits. The scrub of text that does not parse could leave the passphrase in one JSON form when the marker for a later form rebuilt an earlier one (a passphrase of a star and a quote), and scrub_file said it had rewritten a file that still held it: the result is checked against every form and redone with one marker, proved over all 21,256 pairs of a small complete space, 28 of which had left a form. A half-written .json.tmp import report in a kept install is scrubbed with the others, and rows E and K point to row A's reason only where row A has one. The coordinator's check of that head found one more path: what the P0 phase CATCHES, as against what a phase raises, was written unscrubbed into the P0 report (a file the debug bundle carries) and into the run's own record, because the backup, the verify, the restore probe and the incremental refresh each write Name: message of whatever the engine raised. Those four texts are now scrubbed where they are made (p0_validation._exception_text) and not by a scrub of the finished report or of the phase's result, which was the first idea and is wrong here: both hold the verdicts (pass, fail) that the restore gate and the P0 panel compare, and an exact-match scrub by a passphrase of pass turns every one of them into the marker and reads a good backup as one that did not verify (a test runs the run with that passphrase, and a mutation that scrubs the whole result fails it). A static test holds every handler of a function that holds the passphrase, in p0_validation.py, release_run.py and the restore child, to using the caught exception only inside a call that scrubs it with the secret, as its class or as a phase error's status and partial, and to asking for no traceback (a log call's exc_info, .exception(), the traceback module, sys.exc_info()); it began as p0_validation.py alone (this PR) and PR #1318 widened it, and it follows no call, so a helper that reads the exception for itself, a bare re-raise, a secret held as **kwargs, a pw or a closure, the engine's failure lines handed back as data and any other module are outside it; its own walk is tested on thirty-three ways a caught exception can reach a text or a function can hold the secret, ten forms it must leave alone and a function it must not read, and forty mutations of the walk are each caught. The run's parameters no longer print the passphrase in their repr, a failed start removes its directory with rmdir (it takes an empty directory and nothing else, so nothing that was in it is ever deleted), and a failure that wraps another (raise from, or one raised while another was handled) is scrubbed from the whole traceback, with a test for each chain. Recorded, not fixed: a cancel that lands after the restore committed reads the phase as cancelled while its install exists, the scrub's own result is not recorded when it runs from finally, and the test that ties UNLOCK_ROUTES to the unlock router's own routes catches a route the router lost but not one it gained. Unit-proved only; no instance has run a release run on it, and the two failed runs are not evidence for row A. Lessons: LESSONS.md, the entries A PHASE'S STATUS WAS THE RUNNER'S, NOT THE CHILD'S; A DIRECTORY MADE FOR ONE ATTEMPT IS NAMED BY SOMETHING THAT CANNOT REPEAT, AND A CHILD'S PIPES ARE READ WHILE IT RUNS; CODEQL READS NAMES; and THE STYLE RATCHET IS A GATE, NOT ADVICE.
